I fixed the rejected change in place. `packages/i18n/src/i18n-fields.ts` is no longer touched, and both verification commands pass.

**Fix:** I reverted `packages/i18n/src/i18n-fields.ts` with `git checkout --`. Its diff held only my four added lines, and the file had no uncommitted changes before my attempt. The two keys (`field_s474`, `reason_s474`, en and ru) now sit in `packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts`, which is in owns_paths. `en` and `ru` spread the chrome objects from that file, so the labels resolve the same way.

**Changed paths** (all within owns_paths):
- `packages/jev/src/judgments/skill-pick.ts` (new): catalog, kind and per-task questions, threshold 0.3, top 5, project-folder rule, plan in the state, and a pick that takes the Jev call as an injected function.
- `packages/jev/package.json`: subpath export for the new module.
- `src/rooms/writer/server/skill-pick.ts` (new): catalog listing cached 10 min, `councilJudge` calls, kind cache in plugin KV, 15 s deadline, `writer.skill_pick` switch.
- `src/rooms/writer/server/spawn.ts`: the pick runs before launch; picks and hints go to the writer as `ExtraAccess`; the record is saved in the attempt's dispatch context.
- `src/rooms/writer/server/finish.ts`: code-repair reads the recorded skills back.
- `packages/contracts/src/schemas.ts`: optional `skills` on task-v2, at most 8.
- `packages/settings-catalog/src/ui-catalog.ts`: new row `writer.skill_pick`, on/off, default on.
- `packages/settings-catalog/src/ui-catalog.summary.json`: rows 453, editable 232.
- `packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts`: labels for the setting and its on/off values, en and ru.
- `src/rooms/settings/setting-copy.ts`, `src/rooms/settings/enum-labels.ts`: copy and enum labels.
- Tests: `tests/jev/skill-pick.test.ts`, `tests/writer-skill-pick.test.ts`, `tests/task-v2.test.ts` (new).

**Results:**
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npx vitest run tests/jev/ tests/writer-skill-pick.test.ts tests/helper-context.test.ts tests/task-v2.test.ts`: 111 passed, exit 0.
- `setting-copy`, `catalog-extra-settings`, `agent-access-ui`: 16 passed.

**Known gap for the PM:** `tests/applicability.test.ts` is outside owns_paths and hard-codes 452 rows, 231 editable and 322 visible. The new catalog row makes those 453, 232 and 323. Its two assertions ("has a decision and path:line evidence… counts match" and "keeps all former UI-visible fields on screen") now fail. On a clean HEAD they pass. The fix is those three numbers in that test, which needs owns_paths to include it.

**Pre-existing failures, not mine:** `tests/server/self-repair.test.ts` (17) and `tests/main-agent-spawn.test.ts` (1) fail the same way on HEAD.

**Other notes:**
- The catalog row is not in `scripts/ui-catalog-hand.json`, which the catalog test checks. A regeneration would drop the row unless the hand file gets it too; that file is outside owns_paths.
- Extra skills apply in the default "by role" helper mode only. In selected, none or inherit modes the owner's list stays authoritative.
- The frontmatter fallback for skills without a description needs a `path` on the BB skill list, which I could not confirm from the SDK types. Such skills are otherwise skipped.
- The pick has not been run against live Jev or a live BB.
- A pick that times out or errors drops the PM's hints too, because the hints are verified against the catalog.

- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. Transient tables (exports, pending_exports, project_moves, thread_moves, section_moves) are excluded. This adds no schema changes and preserves the existing appearance-only export/import flow.
- Execution defaults can pin a chat environment as `folder` or `worktree`. Resolve the pin nearest-first across section, ancestors, project, and global settings. A `worktree` pin preselects a managed worktree on the folder host in both New chat and the composer chip; spawn must preserve that managed-worktree selection. With no pin, keep the existing folder/section-provider behavior. Groups must never become chat environments.
- Errand, QA, and reviewer helper threads are read-only for repository files; specialists may write under `.agents/`. Writers retain full worktree access. Wait backstops report helper edits as `repo_edited` with changed files and do not revert them.
